summary:
AstraPulse is an offline-first astronaut health intelligence and mission decision-support cockpit engineered for deep-space transit beyond Earth's light-time horizon. On long-duration missions to Mars or lunar outposts, astronauts face NASA’s 5 Spaceflight Hazards (RIDGE) with communication delays of 3 to 22 minutes and zero emergency medical evacuation. 

Rather than applying rigid population thresholds, AstraPulse establishes personalized dynamic baselines using outlier-resistant statistics (Median and MAD with an IQR floor, directional adverse Z-scores, and Theil–Sen trend slopes) across 20 physiological, cognitive, and habitat metrics. When subtle multi-system anomalies emerge—such as compounding sleep loss, elevated bunk CO₂, and cardiovascular strain—AstraPulse provides explainable, evidence-linked alerts and a non-diagnostic Three-Tier Care Guide. It runs fully offline with local IndexedDB sync, encrypted private journals, and an interactive 3D orbital digital twin, empowering astronauts to independently protect mission integrity.
details:
WHAT DOES IT DO & HOW DOES IT WORK?

AstraPulse is an autonomous health intelligence platform designed for deep-space exploration crews aboard long-duration transit vehicles like ARES-01.

The application unifies 14 tactical operational modules:

1. Crew Core: A central cockpit featuring an anatomically segmented, interactive SVG Living Body Twin (front and rear views with 10 biometric hotspots), an orbiting 5-Node NASA RIDGE Hazard Ring, and confidence-weighted Vitality Rings.

2. Pure Functional Analytics Engine: Evaluates 20 physiological and habitat metrics against an astronaut's own 14-day rolling baseline using robust statistics (Median + MAD with an IQR floor, modified Z-scores, and Theil–Sen slope estimators).

3. Autonomous Measure Lab: Includes a calibrated millisecond-accurate Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) reaction test, dual-reading blood pressure averaging, and an ultrasound millimeter distance caliper for optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) tracking.

4. Deep-Space Communications Simulator: Calculates real-time speed-of-light radio delay (D/c) and transfer times based on astronomical distance (up to 22 minutes one-way), utilizing an idempotent store-and-forward queue.

5. Interactive 3D Orbital Habitat: A Three.js WebGL orbital habitat with real-time telemetry-driven rotation and module status lighting.

INTENDED IMPACT & BENEFITS

In deep space, emergency medical evacuation to Earth is impossible, and light-time delays prevent real-time telemedicine. Catastrophic medical emergencies begin as insidious, multi-system drifts across days or weeks. AstraPulse enables early detection of complex anomalies (demonstrated in our seeded ASTRA-002 scenario where sleep curtailment, elevated sleeping-bunk CO₂, and resting heart rate drift compound) before clinical incapacitation occurs.

CREATIVITY & ORIGINALITY

Unlike conventional medical apps that rely on generic population averages or black-box AI diagnosis, AstraPulse introduces:

- Statistical Individualization: Uses robust non-parametric statistics specifically designed for small crew cohorts (N=4), preventing zero-variance collapse.

- Three-Tier Demonstration Care Guide: Adheres strictly to non-diagnostic decision support (Tier 1 Self-Care, Tier 2 Crew Medical Officer Checklist, Tier 3 Ground Escalation Packet) with an automated denylist for clinical/drug terms.

- Privacy-by-Design: Astronaut journals are encrypted on-device; flight surgeons can only access wellness data through time-expiring consent tokens.

- Offline-First Architecture: Built with client-side IndexedDB (Dexie) so zero check-ins are lost during 2-week solar conjunction communication blackouts.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Motion, Three.js (WebGL 3D Scene), Recharts

- Backend: Node.js, Express, WebSocket API (live audio streaming bridge)

- Storage & Sync: Dexie.js (browser IndexedDB), Google Cloud Firestore & Firebase Auth

- PDF Reporting: jsPDF client-side report generator

- Testing & Quality: Node.js test runner (tsx), TypeScript strict checking (zero errors)
